svg.text: B1 - Algorithm32 profile directional spectral-radiance error
Algorithm32 is the selected cumulative-through-order-4 result. Open diamonds are paper Figure 5 values; faint lines are optional local model cross-checks.
Algorithm32 is scored against the same Kider measurements at all 17 times. Paper model values are numeric only at the three displayed Figure 5 times.
